items.en: «New Tu-22M3s, Tu-160s Are Not Really Being Built, Tu-214 Deliveries Average Just One Year: So What Is Kazan Aircraft Plant Doing?» (Defense Express) — Ukrainian analysis says Kazan Aircraft Plant has delivered one Tu-22M3M, up to five Tu-160M2s and three Tu-214s since 2022, far below Russian targets

items.en: Ukrainian intelligence: Russia can probably add 10–15 Su-34s a year, but builds no new Tu-95s, Tu-22M3s or Su-24s
items.nl: Oekraïense inlichtingendienst: Rusland kan vermoedelijk 10–15 Su-34's per jaar toevoegen, maar bouwt geen nieuwe Tu-95's, Tu-22M3's of Su-24's
items.sEn: In a reply published by the Ukrainian news agency UNIAN on 23 October, Ukraine's military intelligence agency HUR said Russian aircraft plants still produce modern fighter-bombers and fighters, enough to partly cover losses. Older bombers are different: Russia has no serial production of new Tu-95s, Tu-22M3s or Su-24s…

items.en: Russia strikes Ukraine overnight 16–17 October with Iskander-M/KN-23, Kh-22/32, Kalibr and 332 drones; no ballistic or Kh-22/32 missiles reported intercepted
items.nl: Rusland valt Oekraïne in nacht van 16 op 17 oktober aan met Iskander-M/KN-23, Kh-22/32, Kalibr en 332 drones; geen ballistische of Kh-22/32-raketten onderschept gemeld

items.en: Sanctions Push Russia's Aviation Industry Into Crisis, Forcing Rostec Restructuring
